'''Printed lore across the retained faces:''' The initial main face and first two ALT faces print “Dathomirian assassin.” The later retained main/ALT faces print “Dathomirian.” The earlier faces have deployment cost 8 and the discount refers to Sith characters “here”; the later faces have deployment cost 6 and the discount refers to Sith characters “on table”.
